get_config: get_config(mode='train') to generate environment config for goal-finding task with square sprite
get_config_test: get_config(mode='test') to generate environment config for goal-finding task with triangle or circle sprite
build_task_config: build a spriteworld environment config dict with FindGoalPosition task and randomized sprite generation
create_factor_distributions: create factor distributions for sprite shape, position, scale, and color using distribs.Product
test_goal_finding: test goal-finding task that generalizes from square training sprites to triangle and circle test sprites
